sentences.text: The Petition relates to a Letter of Intent ("LoI") in regard to a slum rehabilitation project at Borivali.

sentences.text: The Petitioner wants excluded from the LoI, three tracts of land, CTS No 148/129 (400.4 sq mts), CTS No 149 (630 sq mts), and CTS No 150 (1380 sq mts), all of village Magathane, Taluka Borivali, Mumbai Suburban District.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhigna Enterprises vs Slum Rehabilitation Authority on 12 February, 2024.json

sentences.text: The LoI is dated 25th April 2019.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhigna Enterprises vs Slum Rehabilitation Authority on 12 February, 2024.json

sentences.text:
